title: Institutional and deployment safety boundary
summary: A candidate content revision is neither a review approval nor a site release. The independently owned Wire Resource Editor/Site Release and Institutional Policy govern releases. Connect Selector governs direct/RPC/Queue routes.
invariants: No silent remote or production publishing from an editor export.
Do not confuse persistence success with publication authority.
Authentication, service registration, role-to-operation grants, host confinement and CSRF protection must be qualified before live service binding.
No ambient root credentials, generic network access, or direct browser access to a database.

provenance.claim: Exact complete v0.3 publisher distribution used for source inventory and regression suite
